OpenRouter.//: One key, many models. Prefer the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable over committing a key here.

Gemini.//: Get a free key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Prefer the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable or user-secrets over committing it here.

Security.//: TrustedOrigins: in production, the site that proxies /api to this API, such as https://your-app.vercel.app. TrustForwardedHeaders and ForwardLimit: only behind a known chain of proxies, with ForwardLimit set to the number of them.
